name: Abrictosaurus
sum: A small, early Early Jurassic heterodontosaurid from Lesotho and South Africa, about 1.2 m long and one of the most basal members of its family.
wsnote: About 1.2 m long and under 45 kg, according to the English Wikipedia revision cited (mass given only as an upper limit).
holotype: NHMUK PV RUB 54 (formerly UCL B54), a partial skull and skeleton from the Upper Elliot Formation of Lesotho.
material: Two individuals are known, from the Upper Elliot Formation of Qacha's Nek District in Lesotho and Cape Province in South Africa; the second is NHMUK PV RUA 100 (UCL A.100), which has caniniforms.
biology: A bipedal herbivore or omnivore with a keratinous beak at the front of the jaws and cheek teeth more widely spaced and lower crowned than in Heterodontosaurus. The holotype lacks tusks, once read as a female trait, but tusks are present in the second specimen, so their absence may reflect youth.
author: Hopson 1975

sources.text: Hopson, J.A. 1975. On the Generic Separation of the Ornithischian Dinosaurs ''Lychorhinus'' and ''Heterodontosaurus'' from the Stormberg Series (Upper Triassic) of South Africa. South African Journal of Science 71(10): 302–305.
